segments.narration: A massive medieval city materialized floating above Lake Constance.
For hours, peasants and townspeople watched cathedral spires and stone walls glow against the sunset.
Newspapers across Europe reported the impossible aerial phenomenon as a genuine ghostly visitation.
Physicists identified it as a rare Fata Morgana, a thermal ducting effect bending light over water.
The floating skyline was actually an inverted, magnified mirror image of an Italian city miles away.
